rationale.automation-bias: Professionals report complacent acceptance, eroded critical thinking, and deskilling.
rationale.quality-debt: Participants observe bloated, redundant, brittle, and difficult-to-maintain AI code.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Practitioners test functionality, business logic, usability, and production readiness.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Workflow embeds manual debugging, review, re-testing, and deployment-readiness decisions.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Users invoke code explanations and seek human-readable AI action histories.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Participants detect forgotten intent and unrequested features during review.
rationale.org-governance: Study examines enterprise policies, accountability roles, disclosure, and adoption barriers.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Participants advocate persistent prompts, edit histories, attribution, and sign-off records.
